snippet.title: Starmasons™ by Luftskip - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Starmasons is a multiplayer FPS where you embody one of many identical statues fighting to become the last one standing. Sneak around in the fast-changing shadows or hide patiently in plain sight by posing as a statue before picking the perfect moment to raise your crossbow.

Starmasons releases on the Epic Games Store February 2026 

Starmasons is developed and published independently by Luftskip, a fresh game development studio based in Oslo, Norway.

Play Starmasons on the Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/no/p/starmasons-4b2837
Game webpage: https://starmasonsgame.com
Studio webpage: https://luftskip.com
Follow Luftskip on socials: https://linktr.ee/luftskip.digital
